description_en: Queries the custom resolution policies of the current account by policy ID and returns the match type, bound domain name, CIDR blocks or line information, rule list, and status. For IP_RANGE policies, ClientIpRanges retains the array order, duplicates, and string content from the most recent successful submission. The query result represents the saved configuration and does not indicate that the configuration has taken effect on all resolution nodes
description_zh: 根据策略 Id 查询当前账号的自定义解析策略，返回匹配类型、绑定域名、地址段或线路信息、规则列表和启停状态。IP_RANGE 策略的 ClientIpRanges 保留最近一次成功提交的数组顺序、重复项及字符串内容。查询结果表示已保存配置，不代表所有解析节点已经生效
name: SdnsGetRuleCategory

parameters.help_en: The policy ID of the current account. This parameter is required. You can obtain the ID from the Id field of CreateSdnsRuleCategory or the list returned by SdnsListRuleCategories. Use a decimal string to prevent precision loss for large integers
parameters.help_zh: 当前账号的策略 Id，必须提供。可从 CreateSdnsRuleCategory 的 Id 或 SdnsListRuleCategories 的列表中获取；使用十进制字符串，避免大整数精度丢失
parameters.name: id

schema.description_en: The successful response of the operation

Data.description_en: The detailed configuration of the specified policy

ClientIpRanges.description_en: The original CIDR block array from the most recent successful submission for an IP_RANGE policy. The array retains the order, duplicates, and content of each string. The response is a JSON array, not a text string of an array. This field is not used for LINE policies
ClientIpRanges.description_zh: IP_RANGE 策略最近一次成功提交的原始地址段数组，保留顺序、重复项和每个字符串内容。响应为 JSON 数组，不是数组文本字符串；LINE 策略不使用此字段

items.description_en: A client address expression, such as 198.51.100.10, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.10-203.0.113.20, 2001:db8:1::/64, or 2001:db8:2::10-2001:db8:2::20. The range includes the start and end addresses. This expression is used to match source IP addresses and is not a returned DNS record. The original saved string is returned

DomainName.description_en: The domain name bound to the policy

Id.description_en: The policy ID, which can be used to query, update, enable, disable, and delete the policy. Process this value as a string to prevent precision loss for large integers
Id.description_zh: 策略 Id，可用于查询、更新、启停和删除。按字符串处理，避免大整数精度丢失

MatchType.description_en:
The match type of the policy. Valid values:
LINE: line policy
IP_RANGE: client CIDR block policy
MatchType.description_zh: 策略匹配类型：LINE 表示线路策略，IP_RANGE 表示客户端地址段策略

RecordLine.description_en: The line display information for LINE policies. For IP_RANGE policies, this field can be empty or omitted
RecordLine.description_zh: LINE 策略的线路展示信息。IP_RANGE 策略下可为空或省略

LineId.description_en:
The line identifier. Valid values:
internal: the Chinese mainland
overseas: outside the Chinese mainland
LineId.description_zh: 线路标识：internal 表示中国地区，overseas 表示境外

LineLabel.description_en: The display name of the line

Paths.description_en: The line selection path, which describes the line conditions at each level. This field applies only to LINE policies. IP_RANGE policies do not use line paths
Paths.description_zh: 线路选择路径，描述各级线路条件。仅适用于 LINE；IP_RANGE 不使用线路路径

Id.description_en: The code of the option at this level. For example, chinanet at the isps level indicates China Telecom. Use valid options for the associated line and maintain consistent hierarchical relationships
Id.description_zh: 该层级选项的编码。例如 isps 层的 chinanet 表示电信。请使用所属线路的有效选项，并保持层级从属关系一致

Key.description_en: The level identifier. For the Chinese mainland, the values are isps, subRegions, and provinces. For regions outside the Chinese mainland, the values are continents and geoRegions. This corresponds to the Level field
Key.description_zh: 层级标识。中国地区使用 isps、subRegions、provinces；境外使用 continents、geoRegions。与 Level 对应

Label.description_en: The display name of the line option. The display name of the default option can be empty
Label.description_zh: 该线路选项的显示名称。默认选项的显示名称可以为空

Level.description_en: The level sequence number of the line. For the Chinese mainland, the levels are 1 (ISP), 2 (area), and 3 (province). For regions outside the Chinese mainland, the levels are 1 (continent) and 2 (country or region)
Level.description_zh: 线路层级序号。中国地区依次为 1（运营商）、2（大区）、3（省份）；境外依次为 1（大洲）、2（地域）

Region.description_en: The line region display information for compatibility with existing clients. This field applies only to LINE policies. For IP_RANGE policies, this field can be empty or omitted
Region.description_zh: 兼容已有客户端的线路地域展示信息，仅适用于 LINE。IP_RANGE 策略下可为空或省略

Area.description_en: The code and display name of the area
Area.description_zh: 大区的编码和显示名称

Id.description_en: The area code. The value x indicates the default item
Id.description_zh: 大区编码。x 表示默认项

Label.description_en: The display name of the area. An empty string can be returned for the default item
Label.description_zh: 大区显示名称。默认项可以返回空字符串

City.description_en: The code and display name of the city. This is a reserved field for compatibility and city-level granularity is not currently provided
City.description_zh: 城市的编码和显示名称。兼容保留字段，当前未提供城市细分

Id.description_en: The city code. This is a reserved field for compatibility. The default value is x, which indicates that no city is specified. The example uses the JSON string literal "x". The double quotes are not part of the actual field content
Id.description_zh: 城市编码。当前为兼容保留字段，默认值为 x，表示未指定城市；示例用 JSON 字符串字面量 "x" 展示，双引号不是实际字段内容

Label.description_en: The display name of the city. This is a reserved field for compatibility and returns an empty string. The example uses the JSON literal "" to represent an empty string. The double quotes are not part of the actual field content
Label.description_zh: 城市显示名称。当前为兼容保留字段，返回空字符串；示例用 JSON 字面量 "" 表示空字符串，双引号不是实际字段内容

Continent.description_en: The code and display name of the continent
Continent.description_zh: 大洲的编码和显示名称

Id.description_en: The continent code. The value x indicates the default item
Id.description_zh: 大洲编码。x 表示默认项

Label.description_en: The display name of the continent. An empty string can be returned for the default item
Label.description_zh: 大洲显示名称。默认项可以返回空字符串

Country.description_en: The code and display name of the country or region
Country.description_zh: 国家或地域的编码和显示名称

Id.description_en: The country or region code. The value x indicates the default item
Id.description_zh: 国家或地域编码。x 表示默认项

Label.description_en: The display name of the country or region. An empty string can be returned for the default item
Label.description_zh: 国家或地域显示名称。默认项可以返回空字符串

Isp.description_en: The code and display name of the ISP
Isp.description_zh: 运营商的编码和显示名称

Id.description_en: The ISP code. The value x indicates the default item
Id.description_zh: 运营商编码。x 表示默认项

Label.description_en: The display name of the ISP. An empty string can be returned for the default item
Label.description_zh: 运营商显示名称。默认项可以返回空字符串

Province.description_en: The code and display name of the province
Province.description_zh: 省份的编码和显示名称

Id.description_en: The province code. The value x indicates the default item
Id.description_zh: 省份编码。x 表示默认项

Label.description_en: The display name of the province. An empty string can be returned for the default item
Label.description_zh: 省份显示名称。默认项可以返回空字符串

Rules.description_en: The list of custom resolution rules included in the policy. If multiple rules have no parameter conditions, only the first rule is selected. Configure multiple return addresses in the same rule
Rules.description_zh: 策略包含的自定义解析规则列表。多个不带参数条件的规则只会优先选择第一条；多个返回地址宜配置在同一条规则中

ArgKeys.description_en: The names and display order of custom parameters. This field can be empty if custom parameters are not used
ArgKeys.description_zh: 自定义参数名称及展示顺序；未使用自定义参数时可为空

items.description_en: The name of a custom parameter, which corresponds to a key in Args
items.description_zh: 一个自定义参数名称，与 Args 的键对应

additionalProperties.description_en: The match value for the corresponding custom parameter
additionalProperties.description_zh: 对应自定义参数的匹配值

Args.description_en: The custom parameter match conditions attached to the rule. If this field is not configured, no parameter restrictions are applied
Args.description_zh: 规则附加的自定义参数匹配条件；未配置时不附加参数限制

Name.description_en: The name of the rule, which is used to identify the rule and cannot replace the policy ID
Name.description_zh: 规则名称，用于识别规则，不能替代策略 Id

Records.description_en: The list of configured DNS records, which can include A and AAAA records. Actual resolution returns only records of the queried type. If the list is empty or does not contain records of the queried type, the system continues to fall back
Records.description_zh: 配置的解析记录列表，可包含 A 和 AAAA。实际解析仅返回所查询类型的记录；列表为空或没有当前查询类型的记录时继续回退

Ip.description_en: The single destination IP address corresponding to the record. If Type is set to 1, this is an IPv4 address, such as 192.0.2.200. If Type is set to 28, this is an IPv6 address, such as 2001:db8::200. Do not use CIDR blocks, IP address ranges, or domain names
Ip.description_zh: 记录对应的单个目标 IP。Type=1 时为 IPv4，例如 192.0.2.200；Type=28 时为 IPv6，例如 2001:db8::200。不使用 CIDR、起止范围或域名

Type.description_en:
The DNS record type. Valid values:
1: A record
28: AAAA record
Enter an integer. Do not use the string A or AAAA
Type.description_zh: DNS 记录类型：1 表示 A 记录，28 表示 AAAA 记录。填写整数，不使用字符串 A 或 AAAA

TypeLabel.description_en: The auxiliary display text for the record type. This text is not used for matching or resolution decisions and can be omitted in requests
TypeLabel.description_zh: 记录类型的展示辅助文本，不参与匹配或解析决策；请求中可以省略

Weight.description_en: The relative weight of the record. This parameter is used to select one record of the same queried type only when ResultMode is set to 1. Set this parameter to a positive integer from 1 to 100. The sum of the weights of all records does not need to be 100. This parameter is not used for selection when ResultMode is set to 0
Weight.description_zh: 记录的相对权重，仅在 ResultMode=1 时用于选择同一查询类型的一条记录。建议设置 1～100 的正整数，各记录权重之和不必为 100；ResultMode=0 时不参与选择

ResultMode.description_en:
The record return mode. Valid values:
0: Returns all records of the queried type.
1: Returns one record of the queried type based on the weight
ResultMode.description_zh: 记录返回方式：0 表示返回所查询类型的全部记录，1 表示按权重返回所查询类型的一条记录

Ttl.description_en: The cache validity period of the record, in seconds. This value must be a positive integer
Ttl.description_zh: 记录的缓存有效期，单位为秒，必须为正整数

Status.description_en:
The policy status. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled
After the policy is enabled, actual resolution requires waiting for configuration propagation
Status.description_zh: 策略状态：0 表示停用，1 表示启用。启用后实际解析需等待配置传播

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to troubleshoot call issues. This is not the policy ID
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的标识，用于排查调用问题，不是策略 Id
